async def act(page):
    # Fill the telephone filter textbox with the phone number
    # First, locate the filter row that contains the cell with name 'Telephone'
    telephone_header_cell = page.get_by_role('cell', name='Telephone', exact=True)
    # Find the row that contains this cell in the filter section (second rowgroup)
    filter_row = page.get_by_role('row').filter(has=telephone_header_cell)
    # Within that row, get the textbox for the telephone filter
    telephone_filter_textbox = filter_row.get_by_role('textbox')
    await telephone_filter_textbox.fill('555-229-3326')
    
    # Click the Search button to apply the filter
    search_button = page.get_by_role('button', name='Search', exact=True)
    await search_button.click()
    
    # Wait for the page to update after filtering
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
    await page.wait_for_timeout(2000)  # Additional wait for UI to update
    
    # Check if a cell with the phone number exists in the table
    telephone_cell = page.get_by_role('cell', name='555-229-3326', exact=True)
    if await telephone_cell.count() > 0:
        # Find the parent row of this cell using filter
        row = page.get_by_role('row').filter(has=telephone_cell)
        # Extract the name and email cells: name is the third cell (index 2), email is the fourth (index 3) in the row
        cells = row.get_by_role('cell')
        name_cell = cells.nth(2)
        email_cell = cells.nth(3)
        name = await name_cell.text_content()
        email = await email_cell.text_content()
        # Print the result as per instruction
        print(f'{name} {email}')
    else:
        # If no cell found, print a not found message
        print('Customer not found with phone number 555-229-3326')
